scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @mohammedsaas/types && npm run build --workspace @mohammedsaas/permissions && npm run build --workspace @mohammedsaas/accounting-engine
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev --workspace @mohammedsaas/api" "npm run dev --workspace @mohammedsaas/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @mohammedsaas/api && npm run build --workspace @mohammedsaas/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @mohammedsaas/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @mohammedsaas/web
